About this home

Tucked away on a peaceful cul-de-sac, 970 Lehigh Street offers a rare blend of period charm, modern updates, and resort-style outdoor living. Built in 1946, this beautiful single-story residence features 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms on a lovely landscaped lot with pool. It's the epitome of effortless California style. Inside, the home is light-filled and thoughtfully designed, balancing openness with comfortable everyday living. The open living, dining and kitchen areas flow seamlessly, framed by warm wood floors and expansive windows. All great for easy day-to-day or fun gatherings with friends. The primary suite offers a tranquil retreat with a built-out closet and spa-inspired bathroom, while two additional bedrooms provide flexibility for whatever you need: family, guests, creative space, gym, office. The current owner uses the third bedroom as an office-library but it could be anything you want. Plus a cozy reading nook at the end of the hall offers the perfect spot to curl up with a book, sip morning coffee, or a quiet stolen moment. Step outside and the love affair continues. The backyard feels like a private boutique resort, centered around an oversized swimmer's pool with a Baja shelf and tucked away outdoor shower. Decking, shaded dining area, alfresco kitchen and multiple seating vignettes create endless spaces for entertaining and relaxing. Perfect for daytime fun or evening hang outs under the stars where the string lights and serene vibes make every evening a special occasion. The meticulous landscaping includes flourishing orange trees so the delicate scent of citrus blossoms and fresh orange slices poolside will be part of your Southern California experience. Additional conveniences include a garage and a dedicated laundry room. Beyond the property, the location offers something for everyone. From the outdoor enthusiasts to coffee aficionados there is quick access and fun options and a community that is easy to love. 970 Lehigh Street, chic, thoughtful, relaxing and ready for you. Come check it out!

Enjoy cool mid-century vibes on a secluded cul-de-sac at this 3 bedroom, 2 bath residence with an oversized swimmers pool, vegetable garden and citrus trees. Light-filled open floor plan of living/dining room with mountain views. A fully equipped chef's kitchen includes a vegetable sink and stainless appliances. A generous master suite with open walk-in closet and serene master bath features terrazzo tiles. In the large backyard, mature trees provide plenty of shade for relaxing poolside and redwood decks and a BBQ area are perfect for dining and entertaining under starry night skies. Fire-pit and lounge seating as well as a baja-step in the dark bottom pool. The house has been renovated & all systems updated. A home office was added as well as a master bedroom suite, all with permits. Walk and bike to world-class mountain trails in a location that is little known to many. With the feel of a boutique hotel, this is your permanent staycation in city.
